items.q: we were playing at the Billy Berg Swing Billie Burke Street Club. For Billy Berg.

ctx.x: Actually, while I was working on the film, we were playing at the Billy Berg Swing Billie Burke Street Club. For Billy Berg.
The Billie Burke. Do you remember exactly what you did in the film? You played on the sound track a little bit, and you arranged some numbers?
I made a number of the arrangements, yes.
